bagPolicy.summary: Van Andel Arena enforces a No Bag policy, allowing only small clutches and bags for medical or parenting needs. This policy aims to reduce contact between guests and security staff.
allowed: Small clutches no larger than 4.5" x 6.5" x 2"
Bags required for medical or parenting needs
bagPolicy.note: Guests with parenting/medical bags must enter through the ADA/Box office entrance for additional security screening.

parking.note: Parking facilities near Van Andel Arena are managed by the City of Grand Rapids. Metered parking is available on surrounding streets, and accessible parking is available in city-owned ramps and lots on a first-come, first-served basis.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Van Andel Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Van Andel Arena offers a variety of food and beverage options through its exclusive partner, Legends Global. The venue emphasizes local flavors and cashless transactions, with gift cards available for purchase. Alcohol purchases require ID validation.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Wheelchair accessible seating and semi-ambulatory seating are located in various sections and levels throughout Van Andel Arena.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: As re-entry is not permitted, patrons who exit the arena for any reason, including to smoke, will not be allowed to re-enter the facility.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: To purchase tickets in-person for Van Andel Arena, Acrisure Amphitheater, DeVos Performance Hall or DeVosPlace shows, please visit our DeVos Place Grand Gallery Box Office at 303 Monroe Ave. DeVos Place Grand Gallery Box Office Hours

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Van Andel Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
